hints.title: Daily Spam Removal Rate Average
hints.text: Calculate the percentage of spam-reported posts that were removed on each day, then take the average of these daily rates.

hints.title: Daily Ratio CTE with Distinct Counting
hints.text: Group actions with extra equal to spam by action date, computing count of distinct removed posts divided by reported posts.

hints.title: Reported Posts Removal Blueprint
hints.text: with DailySpam as (select a.action_date, count(distinct r.post_id) / count(distinct a.post_id) as removal_rate from Actions a left join Removals r on a.post_id = r.post_id where a.extra = "spam" group by a.action_date) select round(avg(removal_rate) * 100, 2) as average_daily_percent from DailySpam.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH DailySpam AS (
    SELECT a.action_date,
           COUNT(DISTINCT r.post_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.post_id) AS removal_rate
    FROM Actions a
    LEFT JOIN Removals r ON a.post_id = r.post_id
    WHERE a.extra = 'spam'
    GROUP BY a.action_date
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(removal_rate) * 100, 2) AS average_daily_percent
FROM DailySpam;
```

complexity.notes: Grouped distinct counts per day followed by average percentage rounding executes in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Averaging across all individual posts directly yields global removal percentage rather than the average of daily rates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Daily aggregation CTE reduces rows down to one record per date before outer average calculation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Computing daily percentage first in a CTE before taking the overall average.

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def reported_posts(actions: pd.DataFrame, removals: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    spam = actions[actions['extra'] == 'spam']
    merged = spam.merge(removals, on='post_id', how='left')
    daily = merged.groupby('action_date').agg(
        reported=('post_id', 'nunique'),
        removed=('remove_date', lambda x: x.dropna().nunique())
    ).reset_index()
    daily['rate'] = daily['removed'] / daily['reported']
    ans = round(daily['rate'].mean() * 100, 2)
    return pd.DataFrame({'average_daily_percent': [ans]})
solutions.approach: Pandas Daily Ratio Aggregation with Mean Calculation
